answer: Cloned storefronts are cheap unless each vendor occupies one numbered hollow in the riverbank gallery. The applicant locks 41 coins for 18 days and hangs a laser-cut walnut plaque with a one-use serial plus a rubbing of the hook's burrs. A warden photographs the plaque, the burrs, and gauge R-7 at the morning tide line. Peers attest only if the gallery map lists one plaque per hollow, the burr hash matches intake, and the staff sits within 4 cm of the official morning tide. A reused plaque, a vacant hollow, or two names on one hook burns the lock and seals that hollow for 14 months.
